# NetSuite says the record already exists {#duplicate-records}

Find the existing record before deciding whether to add a new one or update what is already there.

<CsvGuideContext slug="duplicate-records" />

## A custom record already uses this identifier {#a-custom-record-already-uses-this-identifier}

**Message looks like**

- `There is already a Custom Record Entry with that name`

**What it means**

Another custom record already uses this name or identifier, so NetSuite will not create a second one.

Import context: General imports.

**Check this first**

Search the record type for the value and decide whether the row should update the existing record instead.

::: details Show the steps

**Steps for this error**

1. Search the custom-record type for the external ID or name used by the failed row.
2. Decide whether the row should update that record or create a different one.
3. Use Update with the existing record’s verified identifier, or assign a genuinely new identifier for Add.

:::

<CsvEntryHelp entry-id="GEN-11" />

- [General Import Errors](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_4568642498.html)

Documentation checked September 16, 2026.

## An entity already uses this external ID {#an-entity-already-uses-this-external-id}

**Message looks like**

- `This entity already exists`

**What it means**

The external ID on the row already belongs to another entity, and two entities cannot share one.

Import context: Leads and prospects.

**Check this first**

Search entities for the failing external ID and decide whether the row should update that record instead.

::: details Show the steps

**Steps for this error**

1. Another entity already uses the external ID being assigned. Find it with an entity saved search filtered to External ID is the failing value, showing ID, name, and type.
2. Decide whether the row should update that record instead of reusing the identifier.
3. Correct the external ID in the file and retry one row.

:::

<CsvEntryHelp entry-id="REL-03" />

- [General Relationship Import Errors](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_4570061540.html)

Documentation checked September 16, 2026.

## A revaluation already uses this item, location, and date {#a-revaluation-already-uses-this-item-location-and-date}

**Message looks like**

- `An Inventory Cost Revaluation Already Exists for this Item, Location, and Date`

**What it means**

A revaluation already exists for this item, location, and date, and each combination can only be used once.

Import context: Inventory cost revaluations.

**Check this first**

Find the existing revaluation and decide whether to update it or change the date.

::: details Show the steps

**Steps for this error**

1. Each revaluation must use a unique combination of item, location, and date. Look for an existing revaluation with the same three values.
2. Change the date or update the existing record instead of adding another for the same combination.
3. Retry one row.

:::

<CsvEntryHelp entry-id="REV-03" />

- [Common Errors When Importing Inventory Cost Revaluation Records](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_3761449045.html)

Documentation checked September 16, 2026.

## The transaction already exists {#the-transaction-already-exists}

**Message looks like**

- `This record already exists`

**What it means**

A transaction with this identifier already exists, so an Add import will not create another one.

Import context: Transactions.

**Check this first**

Find the existing transaction and decide whether the row should update it instead.

::: details Show the steps

**Steps for this error**

1. Search the target transaction type for the external ID or transaction identifier in the failed row.
2. Decide whether the row is a new transaction or an update to the one found.
3. Use the verified existing identifier for Update, or supply a new unique identifier for Add.

:::

<CsvEntryHelp entry-id="TXN-03" />

- [General Transaction Import Errors](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_4570011199.html)

Documentation checked September 16, 2026.
